title: How Many Times Does It Appear
statement:
A text `s` and a pattern `p` are given. Count how many positions of `s` start an exact copy of `p`. Copies may overlap: in `aaaa` the pattern `aa` starts at three positions.

## Input
The first line contains `s`. The second line contains `p`.

## Output
Print the number of starting positions where `p` occurs in `s`.

## Constraints
- `1 <= |p| <= |s| <= 100000`
- `|s| + |p| <= 190000`
- Both strings contain only lowercase letters `a` to `z`
